title: Premium Bills Void at the End of Coverage
content:
# Premium Bills Void at the End of Coverage

Premium billing unit clause on terminated CHIP memberships — Medicaid Managed Care Membership lockout balances.

## Clause

Which bills are owed follows the bills issued around the end of coverage: where the most recent bill is for a coverage month that began after the termination date and was posted before the termination date, that bill alone is void; where the most recent bill is for a coverage month that began after the termination date and was posted on or after the termination date, every bill posted on or after the termination date is void; otherwise every unsettled month is owed.

A void bill is not an owed month of the lockout balance; the other unsettled months — billed months carrying no payment or waiver — remain owed.

## Terms

- **Most recent bill** — the premium bill posted most recently on the ended membership's premium account.
- **Termination date** — the date recorded on the membership as the end of coverage.
- **Began after the termination date** — the first day of the coverage month billed falls later than the termination date. A coverage month beginning on or before the termination date did not begin after it.
- **Posted before, or on or after** — compared with the bill's posted date; a bill posted on the termination date itself is posted on or after it.

## Ladder

| Most recent bill: coverage month | Most recent bill: posted | Void | Owed |
|---|---|---|---|
| began after the termination date | before the termination date | that bill alone | every other unsettled month |
| began after the termination date | on or after the termination date | every bill posted on or after the termination date | every other unsettled month |
| began on or before the termination date | any | none | every unsettled month |

## Dated cases (hypothetical)

*Hypothetical termination date: 2026-05-31.*

1. Most recent bill for coverage month 2026-06, posted 2026-05-20. June began after the termination date and the bill was posted before it: that bill alone is void.
2. Most recent bill for coverage month 2026-07, posted 2026-06-20, with a bill for 2026-06 posted 2026-05-31. July began after the termination date and its bill was posted on or after it: every bill posted on or after 2026-05-31 is void, which takes in both the June bill and the July bill.
3. Most recent bill for coverage month 2026-05, posted 2026-04-20. May did not begin after the termination date: every unsettled month is owed.
